entries.title: Jeremiah 28:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: The fourth year - Perhaps the fourth year of the sabbatical course is here intended. Of Gibeon - it is probable from the place where he lived, which was one of the cities of the priests; that he was a priest.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:13
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: But - Thou hast further incensed God against them, and provoked him to make their judgment heavier.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:17
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Died - Within two months after Jeremiah had thus prophesied; so dangerous a thing it is for ministers to teach people contrary to the revealed will of God.
